text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a NEW high-resolution prop asset catalog board with exactly 12 separate cells arranged 4 columns by 3 rows. These are candidate props for future drama production. Each listed object or coherent set goes in one cell, in row-major order. 1 compact cream single induction hob with dark circular cooking zone and simple dial; 2 cream two-slot toaster empty; 3 small cream electric kettle; 4 stainless tea infuser and closed small pale blue tea tin with no words; 5 pale blue mechanical kitchen timer with clear simple tickmarks; 6 compact ivory digital kitchen scale with clean steel weighing disk; 7 short handled cream Y vegetable peeler; 8 blue silicone pot grippers and matching round trivet as one set; 9 three clear glass leftover storage boxes with pale blue airtight lids; 10 cream lint roller with replaceable paper roll; 11 small pale oak soft bristle pet brush; 12 short wooden interactive cat toy wand with blue fabric ribbon and simple felt fish, ribbon arranged compactly entirely in cell. Photoreal cozy cat-care household props, matte cream pale blue light oak palette, practical small tools and utensils with credible proportions. No animals or cat-shaped body parts. FULLY OPAQUE PURE WHITE seamless backgrounds, RGB not transparency. Soft neutral studio illumination, faint contact shadows, natural tactile materials, no oily highlights. Every item fully visible and wholly contained inside its cell with generous white margin. No people, hands, bodies, mannequins, rooms, brand logos, watermarks or cell labels. No extra objects. Landscape 4:3 canvas. Maintain consistent photographic catalog tone throughout.
reproduction_note: 本批为新设计的备选道具，基于剧本场景和合理制作需求；不代表已出镜或剧情已定稿。格序从左到右、从上到下。
